notes.title: Version V1.1.5 Update-the cloud save functionality will be restored
notes.content:
Version V1.1.5 Update:
Dear generals,

Cloud saving has been re-enabled. To activate the cloud save feature, simply update to version V1.1.5. Some players may encounter issues where their save files are not being uploaded to the cloud. In such cases, you can manually override and upload your saves.

(1) Step 1: Locate the save folder: C:\Users<Your User>\AppData\LocalLow\zjy, and open the 'back' folder. (Note: Some computers may have AppData hidden. You can unhide it by going to the 'View' menu in the file menu bar and checking 'Hidden items.')

(2) Step 2: Select a recent save folder within the 'back' folder and open it. Choose a save from before the V1.1.5 cloud save update, for example, a version from before March 1st.

(3) Step 3: Copy all files in the save folder for later use, including: Version, allVersion, allVersion_temp/Player, Player-prev, etc.

(4) Step 4: Return to the LocalLow\zjy folder, open 'zygame_steam,' and paste the files copied in Step 3 to overwrite the original files.

(5) Step 5: Restart the game. Your manual saves will appear in the list. Old saves will lack thumbnails and appear white. You can enter them by clicking, then manually save to overwrite the old saves and update the thumbnails (optional operation for those who find the blank thumbnails uncomfortable).

[olist]
[*] Fixed the bug where material icons were not displayed after dropping.
[*] Fixed the bug where players could get stuck inside Xinye City when attacking Cao Ren.
[*] Fixed the bug that displayed Du Ruo abnormally after the date with Xiahou Lan in Zhengli.
[*] Fixed the asynchronous display bug of teleportation point icons on the map.
[*] Fixed the bug in the Cao Ren boss battle in Bamenjinsuo where Cao Ren couldn't return after entering the shield formation.
[/olist]
Optimizations:

[olist]
[*] Ongoing optimization of the Changban Slope scene for smoother gameplay and improved level experience.
[*] Reduced the weight of cavalry charge attacks; adjusted the attack rhythm of units like Longspear Bandits, reducing turning and tracking abilities.
[*] Added elemental symbols to the Ling Seal icon for better representation of level, elemental type, and attack/defense differences.
[*] Optimized the frame rate issue in the Arrow Rain section of the On the Yixiantian stage.
[*] Adjusted and optimized the air wall in the Boss battle at Woniu Mountain, increasing the combat area.
[*] Normalization of cloud save functionality
[/olist]
Thank you for your understanding and support, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun updateV1.0.8
notes.content:
Version V1.0.8 Update:

Dear generals! Thank you for your active feedback. We have continued to optimize the game. 
In this version update, we focused on fixing the problem of certain mission teleportation points disappearing；fixes the issue of appearance loss bugs,；and restores the save overwrite functionality.
Specific updates are as follows.

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue where the Jie Bridge mission did not unlock the Gong SunZhan's camp teleportation point after completion.
[*] Fixed the issue where the teleportation point to the Hutu River did not unlock.
[*] Fixed the issue where, through special operations during decomposition, it was possible to obtain materials without consuming equipment.
[*] Fixed the situation in Cutscene where Zhao Yun would be attacked by archers.
[*] Fixed the issue where the teleportation point for the mission to seek aid in Xuchang was not unlocked.
[*] Fixed the problem where equipment pickup settings were sometimes ineffective.
[*] Adjusted purple gathering items (except gemstone raw stones) to allow two collections per refresh round.
[*] Optimized the addition of equipment parts to both equipment and equipment blueprints.
[*] Optimized some of Zhao Yun's action transition states.
[*] Optimized performance in some Cutscene.
[*] Optimized the position of some scene chests to prevent getting stuck.
[*] Optimized the horse-riding areas in Longcou and Yijing. In Longcou, horse riding in certain areas is now allowed; removed the no-riding zone outside the military camp in Yijing.
[*] Enabled the save overwrite function.
[*] Removed the mechanism for automatic to manual transmission (Note: If a player has no manual saves, the previous automatic save will become manual upon starting the game again; if there are manual saves, it will not change).
[*] Corrected Zhao Yun's skin appearance levels to 20 (Feathered Cavalry), 30 (Centurion), 40 (White Horse Warrior), and 50 (General).
[*] Temporarily disabled other tabs/options in the Bagua Furnace.
[*]Increased the priority of executions, allowing the skill to be interrupted at any time during execution.
[/olist]
Thank you for your understanding and support, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.title: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun updateV1.0.6
notes.content:
Version V1.0.6 Update:

Hello, dear generals! Thank you for your active feedback, and we will continue to optimize the game. This update focuses on fixing main quest freezes, strengthening Zhao Yun's super armor, and enhancing skill abilities.
Other updates include:

[olist]
[*] Fixed the issue where the Execute keybinding replacement didn't change the UI for other keybindings.
[*] Fixed the abnormal terrain issue in the Mine Cave at the back mountain.
[*] Adjusted the level of the warhorse given by Moonlit White.
[*] Optimized the lack of prompt when deleting a save.
[*] Added a shop before the battle with Mountain Shrine and Xiahou Lan.
[*] Added a bug fix feature [If encountering a main quest freeze bug in the game, you can use this feature to reload and resolve the issue].
[*] Optimized all ESC skip keys: Supports skipping immediately by pressing ESC or clicking the button with the mouse.
[*] Added the herb shop Dragon's Grass (warhorse resurrection material) available at stores from level 30 and beyond.
[*] Adjusted and increased the super armor values of all Zhao Yun's skills, including on the ground and while mounted, to avoid being dismounted too easily during mounted combat and being interrupted too easily on the ground.
[*] Optimized the bad file repair feature.
[*] Adjusted skill modifications:
[list]
[*] Rising Moon, Whipping Thunder, Rising Eagle, Swallow Whirl: Pre-animation is now immune to physical damage, preventing interruption when casting.
[*] Cloudshift, Abysmal Dive, Thunderous Gale: Entire duration is immune to physical damage.
[*] Cascading Waves: Increased block capability.
[*] Overlord Sweep: Ignores block and increased knockback distance.
[*] Horizon Cleave: Pre-animation is now immune to physical damage, and increased knockback distance.
[*] Phoenix's Praise: Added a second hit of damage.
[/list]
[/olist]

Button for Bug Fix Feature:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43164775/345a17efd6195a900ec313f6e55c857b2c0a6582.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your understanding and support, and we hope you continue to enjoy the game!

notes.content:

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused by issues arising from conflicts between Cloud Settings and local save functions. We are sincerely sorry for any imperfections in the game experience. notes.title: Upcoming Release-Jan 18th-Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun
notes.content:
Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun will be officially released on 0:00 AM January 18th 2024 PST, priced at $19.99. Launch discount: 10% OFF

- Master 4 distinct weapon systems: spears, bows and arrows, swords, and steeds, supplemented by equipment systems like crafting, sets, refinement, and enchantment.

notes.title: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun-Delayed release until January
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are the publisher of the Legend of Zhao Yun: Yunhan Teng Dragon. The game was originally scheduled to be released on December 7th, but we found some problems that affected the normal experience of the game during several internal tests. After repeated communication with the development team, in order to ensure the quality of the game, we decided to postpone the release of the game to mid-to-late January.

Currently, we have found the following issues in our internal testing of the full version:
(1) The new screen detail elements cause some scenes to stall, which requires high configuration requirements and takes time to adapt and optimize the performance
(2) Sword skill system, special effects, etc. have been developed, but it takes time to polish to the state of launch
(3) There is a large amount of plot, and there are some problems in the detail optimization of dubbing and lines in the story line

The above problems may affect everyone's game experience to a certain extent, our comprehensive evaluation, the current version has not reached the best state of sale, comprehensive decision to postpone the launch. At present, we have determined the solution, and we want to gain time to polish the content details and experience. We hope you can give us some more time.

notes.content:
亲爱的玩家朋友们， 
大家好！重磅消息！！《赵云传重制版》先锋营玩家试玩招募开始啦！ 
为了更好地开发和优化游戏，充分听取玩家们的意见，一起让《赵云传重制版》变得更好，我们计划招募一批核心玩家不定期提前开启部分游戏章节流程内容试玩，以便提出玩家向的体验优化的建议。 
温馨提示：封闭测试或试玩版本内容有较多不完善支出，必定存在较多BUG，不代表游戏上线时的最终品质，因此不建议普通玩家 或 对初期版本品质要求较高的玩家 参与封闭试玩，建议普通玩家静待正式完整版本发售。 
 
招募时间：5月29日-6月4日； 
招募名额：20名 
报名形式：意向参与本次测试招募的玩家需要先加入【赵云传重制版】QQ频道下的【官方活动】专区，填写问卷参与报名 
试玩时间：不定期开启，以QQ频道信息为准 
 
⚠希望您能做到： 
1.测试试玩中出现的内容并非最终版本，请勿在测试期间进行直播、截图、文字、录像分享，如封闭测试中内容被外泄开发组有权利即时关闭测试，并追究泄露责任方； 
2.拥有比较自由且较长段的时间可投入游戏体验中； 
3.多角度发现游戏BUG及优化点，并能在QQ频道中提出； 
3.积极反馈和表达自己的游戏体验感受，我们希望您： 
    1）是赵云IP粉丝和喜好RPG类游戏的玩家；

    3）善于思考总结并提出合理游戏建议玩家； 
 
招募声明： 
1.招募将会长期进行，定期筛选一批核心玩家加入测试。 
2.招募结束后被选中的玩家将由官方频道管理员拉入内测子频道分组，请及时留意自己的频道私信噢~ 
3.如果长期没有反馈有效建议，有可能会被开发组暂时取消封闭测试权限，以便邀请更多热情玩家参与体验，希望大家理解。 
 
在测试期内认真体验游戏，积极反馈在游戏过程遇到的问题，可以加入游戏制作鸣谢名单！

notes.title: Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun Lü Bu and other character settings were announced now!
notes.content:
Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun is an RPG single-player game developed by Zuijiangyue Studio and published by Yijiang Time Studio, and the first closed beta time is adjusted to January 4, 2023. The development team released classic supporting character vertical painting settings, which are Xia Houlan, Lü Bu, Pei Yuanshao, and Zhang Yan. In the story of Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun, what kind of story will these characters have with the protagonist Zhao Zilong as bosses or partners?

Add to wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2201710/

Xiahoulan
Xia Houlan and Zhao Yun are in the same village, grew with Fan Juan, the three have played from childhood to adulthood, and learned art from a teacher together. Zhao Yun's gun skills are extraordinary, and Xia Houlan specializes in swordsmanship. The setting of Xia Houlan in Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun is more inclined to a swordsman, handsome and dashing on the outside, but equally resolute on the inside. After some trials and experiences in their hometown, the two went to different roads separately. What is the cause of this chaos in the world? How to end this troubled world? Is it by power to restore order? Or is it the first thing to be benevolent to the people? The collision of ideas will always accompany the story of Zhao Yun and Xia Houlan, and many conflicts will break out. As the actor of the protagonist, which concept do you recognize more to end the chaos?
Lü Bu
Lü Fengxian is the ceiling of the combat power of the martial generals of the Three Kingdoms, and in the story of the original game, Lü Bu has a lot of scenes as the final boss. The overall plot story of Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun tends to be realistic, and Lü Bu, as an important boss, has more scenes in the early stage, which is a difficult challenge that the protagonist Zhao Yun has to face in the early stage. In addition, the mink cicada that advances and retreats with Lv Bu is known as a beautiful appearance, and his appearance is unparalleled in the Three Kingdoms, how much will Zhao Yun intersect with the mink cicada in the story of Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun. Many players have been waiting for it.
Pei Yuanshao
Pei Yuanshao, who went from the Yellow Turban Army to banditry, was an important boss and helper of the original Zhao Yun. After being defeated by Zhao Yun, he was impressed by Zhao Zilong's martial arts and courage, and was willing to follow Zhao Yun loyally. Pei Yuanshao in Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun still appears as an important role, the image setting pays more attention to details, the characters' expressions are optimistic, and the image of the "law-abiding thief" who is bitter and happy jumps on the paper.
Zhang Yan
Zhang Yan, the leader of the Black Mountain Army, is also from Zhao Yun's hometown Zhending County, Changshan Commandery. From the Yellow Turban Army to the Black Mountain Army, Zhang Yan was known as a bandit, and the Black Mountain Army entrenched in Hebei had many conflicts with the forces of Gongsun Zan and Yuan Shao, which inevitably involved Zhao Yun and his fellow villagers in the war. In the plot of Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun, the "official army" of Yuan Shao, who has lax military discipline, runs amok in the countryside and the people in the name of suppressing bandits. For ordinary people, is bandits more harmful, or is the official and military more harmful? The bandits were also ordinary people before they fell into the grass, were they really full of evil? All this requires players to look inside the game to find the answers.
About Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun
    Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun is an ARPG single-player game developed by Zuijiangyue Studio and published by ETimeStudio, newly developed and produced by the core team of the original Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun. On the basis of continuing the original setting, the art is newly produced, the plot is newly written and the game adopts real-time combat, with three completely different styles of battle modes: gun, bow, and riding, and with a large number of content such as skill combinations, talent trade-offs, random equipment, etc.
    In Three Kingdoms Zhao Yun, players can experience the magnificent Three Kingdoms era by playing Zhao Zilong, meet heroes of various eras, challenge various murderers, and compose different experiences and stories with many heroines with different personalities.
    Who has not been young? who does not dream of becoming Zhao Zilong?
